finding.summary: The tool-call loop only handles tc.name == "read_file"; any other tool name the model emits (hallucinated calls happen with tool_choice auto) produces no tool-role message for that tool_call_id. The next chat() request then contains an assistant message with tool_calls that is not followed by a matching tool result, which OpenAI-compatible APIs reject with a non-retryable 400. That LLMError aborts the entire PR review (nothing posted), and tool_calls_made is not incremented for unknown names so the run cannot even reach the read-limit fallback.
finding.fix: Add an else branch inside the tool-call loop that appends a tool message for unrecognized calls, e.g. {"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": "Error: unknown tool '<name>'. Only read_file is available."}, and increment tool_calls_made so the read-limit machinery still applies.
